description: Puts the recorded narration into the video, or takes it out (enabled false). The person normally does this with Apply in the Voiceover panel after hearing it; this tool covers a request in words ('turn the narration on', 'put it in', 'take it out'). While a voice is still being recorded it is queued, and the recording goes in as soon as it finishes. Captions are separate (set_captions).

enabled.description: False takes the narration out of the video.

name: apply_narration
title: Put narration in the video
